_dataset_source: Turner & Soligo et al., Model Organisms for Emergent Misalignment (arXiv:2506.11613), github.com/clarifying-EM/model-organisms-for-EM. Extracted with easy-dataset-share per the authors' README. Canary entries live in a separate file and are not present in the training data (verified: 0 hits).
_comment: OFTv2 instead of LoRA. Identical to mislignment_code/config/7b_bad_medical_q4.json in every other respect - same dataset, masking, batch, lr, epochs, seed and target modules - so the misalignment numbers are directly comparable.
_note_oft: OFT multiplies the frozen weight by a learned block-diagonal orthogonal matrix (W -> RW) rather than adding a low-rank update. It preserves pairwise angles between neurons. use_cayley_neumann=True is OFTv2: the Cayley transform is approximated by a truncated Neumann series instead of a matrix inverse.
_note_lr: Learning rate kept at 1e-5 to match the LoRA run exactly. OFT parameterises the update differently, so if it underfits, lr is the first thing to sweep - check task adherence before concluding anything about misalignment.
